about: The supplies show more than 28 consecutive days of aspirin and clopidogrel after the stroke, and the stroke clinic confirms secondary prevention and excludes all three exceptions.
Possible finding: supplies of a daily aspirin tablet fraction and clopidogrel support more than 28 consecutive days together, but the reason for dual treatment and the exceptions are unknown.
Cartia (aspirin) and Plavix (clopidogrel) are both supplied eight times after a stroke, but a coronary stent was put in on 10 February 2026, within the previous 12 months, so there is no finding.
